kinds.name: secret_provider
kinds.doc:
A provider of secrets. One instance is one configuration of one provider. Every setting has a default, so a host can make an
instance with none to describe the provider before anyone has set it up.

A value is text. A provider that is asked something it cannot do answers `UNSUPPORTED` ([`unsupported`]); one that cannot be
reached or has not been unlocked answers `GONE` ([`unavailable`]) with a reason that holds no value, and the host asks
the person instead.

slots.name: describe
slots.doc: What it is and can do. Cheap, and the same on every call.

slots.name: names
slots.doc: The names it holds, and nothing else. `UNSUPPORTED` when [`ProviderInfo::can_list`] is false.

slots.name: get
slots.doc: What it holds under `request`'s name: [`Held::none`] when nothing.

slots.name: put
slots.doc: Keeps a value, replacing one of that name. `UNSUPPORTED` when [`ProviderInfo::can_store`] is false.

slots.name: forget
slots.doc: Forgets what it keeps under the name; not having it is no error. `UNSUPPORTED` when [`ProviderInfo::can_store`] is false.
